articles.summary: Arteris announces the expansion of its third-party IP (3PIP) security assurance program in collaboration with BAE Systems and SiFive, Inc.
articles.title: Arteris Wins Funding to Expand Hardware Design Supply Chain Security Assurance for the Trusted and Assured Microelectronics Program

articles.summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act brings cybersecurity and documentation responsibilities to semiconductor and IP suppliers whose products enter the EU market. The article outlines how suppliers can assess which requirements may apply and organize security evidence to support customers’ readiness.
articles.title: Semiconductor Engineering: The EU Cyber Resilience Act Reaches Chip And IP Suppliers

articles.summary: This article explains how AI can speed up engineering research and bug discovery when engineers can verify the results. Drawing on the work developing Arteris’ JIG C++ verification library, it shows how built-in checks give AI clear criteria to explore while keeping design decisions and engineering judgment with the team.
articles.title: From Bug Hunting to Engineering Methodology: Lessons from AI-Driven Development

articles.summary: This article argues that semiconductor advances are now shaping products and competition across industries, even for companies that don’t design chips. He encourages business leaders to build enough semiconductor fluency to understand where silicon can create an advantage and how to work with technology partners.
articles.title: Forbes: Why Every Industry Is Becoming A Semiconductor Industry
